jobs.title: Campus Public Safety Officer | First Responder
jobs.description:
Saint Xavier University in Chicago is hiring a University Police Officer to protect and serve the campus community. The role involves routine patrols, responding to emergencies, and engaging with students and staff to foster a safe environment.

Applicants should have a Bachelor’s degree or relevant experience, and must be certified as a Basic Law Enforcement Officer in Illinois. The position requires strong communication skills, physical fitness, and community engagement. This role plays a vital role in supporting the university's mission and ensuring a welcoming atmosphere.
